overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（10 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（2 篇）。方法上以模型校准、回归分析为主。来源分布：OpenAlex（7 篇）、arXiv（5 篇）。

papers.title: Interpretable machine learning prognostication of gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors across Chinese and United States cohorts
papers.abstract:
Background
                    Gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NETs) display marked clinical heterogeneity, and conventional prognostic indicators such as TNM stage and Ki-67 index provide limited individualized risk discrimination. We aimed to develop and externally validate interpretable machine learning models for survival prediction.
                  
                  
                    Methods
                    This retrospective study enrolled 337 patients with histologically confirmed GEP-NETs, randomly partitioned into a training set (n = 236) and an independent test set (n = 101) with stratification by mortality. Six survival models, including unpenalized Cox regression as a baseline, LASSO Cox, random survival forest (RSF), gradient-boosted survival analysis (GBSA), Extra Trees, and DeepSurv, were trained with 5×5 nested cross-validation. Discrimination, probabilistic accuracy, calibration, and clinical utility were comprehensively evaluated. SHAP analysis identified key predictors and informed nomogram construction. External validation was performed in 51,225 SEER patients.
                  
                  
                    Results
                    On the test set, Extra Trees achieved the highest discrimination (C-index 0.843, 95% CI 0.762-0.914) and balanced calibration (1-year ICI 0.031). Time-dependent AUC values were 0.871, 0.847 and 0.935 at 1, 3 and 5 years. The Extra Trees-based stratification identified high-risk patients with substantially worse survival (HR 8.93, 95% CI 3.35-23.84, P&lt;0.001). The model outperformed TNM stage (C-index 0.772), Ki-67 (0.705) and tumor grade (0.699). Decision curve analysis demonstrated greater net benefit across threshold probabilities of 5%-50%. SHAP analysis identified T stage, tumor grade, M1 status, TNM stage and Ki-67 as the top predictors. External validation in SEER preserved discriminative ability (C-index 0.719) and excellent calibration (slopes 0.901-1.058).
                  
                  
                    Conclusion
                    Interpretable machine learning models outperform conventional approaches in predicting GEP-NET survival. Extra Trees showed the best internal discrimination and calibration, whereas DeepSurv achieved the highest external C-index. The simplified SHAP-derived nomogram provides a practical and well-calibrated but exploratory tool for individualized prognosis that requires prospective validation before clinical use.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】**背景**  
胃肠胰神经内分泌肿瘤（GEP-NETs）表现出显著的临床异质性，传统的预后指标（如TNM分期和Ki-67指数）在个体化风险评估方面的能力有限。本研究旨在开发并外部验证可用于生存预测的可解释机器学习模型。  

**方法**  
本研究纳入了337名组织学确诊的GEP-NET患者，根据死亡风险将其随机分为训练集（n = 236）和独立测试集（n = 101）。共训练了六种生存模型，包括基线模型（未加惩罚的Cox回归）、LASSO Cox回归、随机生存森林（RSF）、梯度提升生存分析（GBSA）、Extra Trees和DeepSurv，并采用5×5嵌套交叉验证方法进行评估。这些模型在区分能力、概率准确性、校准性能和临床实用性方面均接受了全面评价。SHAP分析帮助确定了关键预测因子，并用于构建预后评分图表。外部验证在51,225名SEER数据库患者中进行。  

**结果**  
在测试集上，Extra Trees模型表现出最高的区分能力（C指数0.843，95%置信区间0.762-0.914）和良好的校准性能（1年ICC值0.031）。其时间依赖性AUC值在1年、...。研究方法：回归分析、模型校准、机器学习、LASSO 正则化。

papers.title: PELAKSANAAN PEMBELAJARAN SOSIOLOGI DENGAN PENDEKATAN DEEP LEARNING DALAM MENINGKATKAN KEAKTIFAN BELAJAR PESERTA DIDIK DI KELAS X 3 SMAN 12 BUNGO
papers.abstract: This research is motivated by the low learning activity of students in Sociology learning in class X 3 of SMAN 12 Bungo which is characterized by the lack of student participation in discussions, courage to express opinions, the ability to ask questions, and involvement in the learning process. The Deep Learning approach is seen as one of the learning alternatives that is able to create a meaningful learning process (meaningful learning), full of awareness (mindful learning), and joyful learning, so that it can increase the active involvement of students. This study aims to describe the implementation of Sociology learning with a Deep Learning approach which includes the planning, implementation, and evaluation stages, as well as identify the advantages and disadvantages of its application in increasing the learning activity of students in class X 3 SMAN 12 Bungo. The theory used in this study is Lev Vygotsky's Social Constructivism Theory as the main basis for analyzing the implementation of Sociology learning with a Deep Learning approach in increasing student activity. This study uses a qualitative approach with a descriptive research type. The research informants were selected using the purposive sampling technique consisting of Sociology teachers and 6 students of class X 3 of SMAN 12 Bungo. Data were collected through observations, in-depth interviews, and documentation studies. Furthermore, data analysis was carried out using the Miles and Huberman model which included data collection, data reduction, data presentation, as well as inference withdrawal and verification. The results of the research conducted in class X 3 of SMAN 12 Bungo show that the implementation of Sociology learning with the Deep Learning approach has been carried out through the stages of planning, implementation, and evaluation. In the planning stage, teachers develop learning tools that internalize the principles of meaningful learning, mindful learning, and joyful learning. The implementation places teachers as facilitators through discussions, analysis of social phenomena, presentations, and contextual learning, while the evaluation includes cognitive aspects and student activity. The application of the Deep Learning approach has been proven to increase students' activeness in visual, oral, listening, motor, mental, and emotional aspects. However, its implementation still faces obstacles in the form of limited facilities, time management, teacher readiness, and differences in student characteristics.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究的动机源于SMAN 12 Bungo学校十年级三班社会学课程中学生学习积极性较低的问题，具体表现为学生参与讨论的积极性不足、表达观点的勇气欠缺、提问能力较弱以及在学习过程中的投入度不高。深度学习方法被视为一种能够促进有意义学习（即具有内在价值的学习）、注重思维过程的学习（即有意识的学习）以及充满乐趣的学习方式，从而有助于提高学生的主动参与度。本研究旨在描述采用深度学习方法进行社会学教学的整个过程，包括计划、实施和评估三个阶段，并分析该方法在提升SMAN 12 Bungo学校十年级三班学生学习积极性方面的优势与不足。本研究以列夫·维果茨基的社会建构主义理论作为主要理论基础，用于分析深度学习方法在提高学生学习积极性方面的作用。研究采用定性研究方法，通过目的性抽样选取了SMAN 12 Bungo学校十年级三班的社会学教师及6名学生作为受访者。数据收集手段包括观察、深入访谈和文献分析。数据分析过程遵循Miles和Huberman模型，包括数据收集、数据简化、数据呈现以及推论的提取与验证。研究结果表明，深度学习方法在SMAN 12 Bungo学校十年级三班的教学中已成功经历了计划、实...。研究方法：深度学习。

papers.title: Learning about Treatment Effects in Panels under Unknown Interference
papers.abstract: When comparison units may also respond to treatment, panel comparisons reflect both the treatment effect and spillovers. If the interference pattern is unknown, observed outcomes alone do not separate the two. I characterize what can nevertheless be learned from panel outcomes under general restrictions, without requiring an exposure mapping or prior classification of affected donors. The framework scales validity bounds for every convex donor weight by its fit before treatment and combines these bounds with prespecified restrictions tailored to the application. The validity bounds constrain the treatment effect relative to spillovers, while the additional restrictions determine its possible values. Together these restrictions yield a sharp identified set. When the additional restrictions have a finite linear representation, checking whether a proposed treatment effect is compatible with the model reduces exactly to asking whether a finite linear system has a solution. Bootstrap calibration tests this condition. Inverting these tests uniformly controls, in large samples, the probability of falsely excluding each compatible value. In an application to the Legal Arizona Workers Act, the resulting 95 percent inversion sets contain effects of both signs across all reported specifications, leaving the sign of the treatment effect unresolved.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】当比较对象也可能对治疗产生反应时，面板比较既反映了治疗效果，也反映了其他影响（即“溢出效应”）。如果这些干扰因素的具体模式未知，仅凭观察到的结果无法区分这两者。本文在一般性限制条件下，探讨了即便如此仍能从面板数据中获取的信息，而无需对受影响的对象进行预先分类或确定其暴露情况。该框架通过每个受影响对象在治疗前的状态来调整有效性界限，并将这些界限与针对具体应用场景制定的额外限制条件相结合。有效性界限用于限定治疗效果相对于溢出效应的范围，而额外的限制条件则决定了治疗效果的可能取值。这些限制条件共同作用，能够明确地识别出有效的治疗效果。当这些额外限制条件可以表示为线性方程时，判断某个假设的治疗效果是否与模型相符，实际上就转化为判断该线性方程是否有解。通过自助法（bootstrap）进行校准测试可以验证这一条件。在大样本情况下，这种校准方法能够统一控制错误排除所有符合模型条件的治疗效果的可能性。在将这一方法应用于《亚利桑那州劳工法》的相关研究中，所得到的95%置信区间包含了所有研究指标中治疗效果的正负两种可能性，但治疗效果的具体符号仍无法确定。。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: Measuring the Arrow of Time: Identification, Estimation, and Inference for Directional Structure in Multivariate Time Series
papers.abstract: Many questions across the sciences take the same form: several coupled series are observed together, and the analyst wants to know not merely that they move together but which one moves first, and how strongly. This paper sets out a complete method built on one organising idea: the direction of a coupled system is exactly the part of its behaviour that changes when the record is played backwards. Tools built on contemporaneous covariance alone (correlation matrices, distance measures, spanning trees, undirected centralities, principal components) carry no information about direction: a reversible system and a circulating one can share identical covariance at every sampling of the same point-in-time record. Formally, direction is a circulation matrix carried by the lagged covariance. Its vanishing is exactly statistical time reversibility for linear systems, feature maps carry the characterisation to nonlinear ones, and under the Gaussian benchmark its magnitude is an entropy-production functional of the identified circulation, the quadratic component of the divergence per unit time between the forward and reversed records. Around this estimand we build a cross-fitted estimator removing first-order bias, delete-block jackknife standard errors, and a randomisation test exact under its stated block null, with a familywise correction and a nonlinear extension. A sampling theory says when the arrow is measurable at all, and a design layer separates transmission from the ordering of clocks. A laboratory of four systems with known answers compares the method with correlation networks, Granger causality, transfer entropy, and connectedness indices, reporting the failures of each when read as a measure of direction, including our own. Complete algorithms and worked examples in two languages make the paper the base reference for a series of applications.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】在众多科学领域中，存在一类相似的研究问题：研究者会观察到多个相互关联的序列，并希望了解这些序列不仅会同时发生变化，还希望知道其中哪个序列会首先发生变化，以及变化的程度如何。本文提出了一种基于核心思想构建的完整分析方法：一个耦合系统的“方向”恰恰是指当系统记录被倒放时其行为发生改变的部分。仅依赖同时性协方差（如相关矩阵、距离度量、生成树、无向中心性、主成分分析）的工具无法揭示系统的方向信息——因为一个可逆系统与一个循环系统在相同时间点的记录中可能具有完全相同的协方差。从形式上讲，系统的方向可以通过滞后协方差矩阵来表征；对于线性系统而言，当滞后协方差矩阵为零时，系统具有统计上的时间可逆性；对于非线性系统，特征映射也能体现这一特性。在高斯基准假设下，该方向矩阵的“大小”反映了系统循环过程的熵产生能力，具体表现为正向记录与反向记录之间的散度在单位时间内的二次变化量。围绕这一统计量，我们构建了一种能够消除一阶偏差的交叉拟合估计方法、基于删除块技术的标准误差估计方法，以及在该假设下严格成立的随机化检验方法（该方法还包含了家族校正和非线性扩展功能）。采样理论用于判断系统方向是否可被测量；设计层...。研究方法：主成分分析。

papers.title: Research on high-speed train wheelset bearing fault diagnosis based on IDBA-CNN
papers.venue: Journal of Engineering and Applied Science
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  To address the challenges in high-speed train wheelset bearing fault diagnosis, including difficulties in optimizing Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) hyperparameters and the tendency of traditional metaheuristic algorithms to get trapped in local optima with imbalanced exploration–exploitation capabilities, this study proposes an intelligent fault diagnosis method that integrates an improved Detective Behavior Algorithm (IDBA) with CNN. First, a Refraction Opposition-Based Learning (ROBL) strategy is designed. By introducing a stochastic refraction coefficient and perturbation terms, the symmetry constraints of the original opposition-based learning are broken, enhancing population diversity. Next, an elite-guided adaptive information-sharing development strategy is implemented, which dynamically adjusts the strength of information sharing based on population fitness variance, achieving an adaptive balance between exploration and exploitation. The IDBA is coupled with the CNN model to automatically optimize critical hyperparameters, constructing an end-to-end fault diagnosis framework. Experimental validation on the self-built HST-WBSet dataset of high-speed train wheelset bearings demonstrates that the proposed method achieves a diagnosis accuracy of 98.96% and a macro-average F1 score of 98.97%, significantly outperforming mainstream comparative models including DBA-CNN, Vision Transformer, Swin Transformer, and CNN-Transformer. Ablation studies further confirm that both the refracted reverse learning strategy and the elite-guided adaptive information-sharing development strategy contribute effectively and synergistically to performance enhancement. This approach provides a systematic and high-precision solution for adaptive fault diagnosis of high-speed train wheelset bearings, improving robustness, accuracy, and practical applicability in industrial monitoring scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
为应对高速列车轮对轴承故障诊断中的挑战——包括优化卷积神经网络（CNN）超参数的难度，以及传统元启发式算法因探索与利用能力不平衡而容易陷入局部最优解的问题——本研究提出了一种智能故障诊断方法，该方法将改进后的检测行为算法（IDBA）与CNN相结合。首先，设计了一种基于折射对立学习（ROBL）的策略。通过引入随机折射系数和扰动项，打破了原有对立学习中的对称性约束，从而增强了种群的多样性。接着，实施了一种精英引导的自适应信息共享发展策略，该策略根据种群适应度方差动态调整信息共享的强度，实现了探索与利用之间的平衡。IDBA与CNN模型相结合，自动优化关键超参数，构建了一个端到端的故障诊断框架。在基于高速列车轮对轴承的自建HST-WBSet数据集上的实验验证表明，所提出的方法诊断准确率为98.96%，宏观平均F1分数为98.97%，显著优于包括DBA-CNN、Vision Transformer、Swin Transformer和CNN-Transformer在内的主流对比模型。消融研究进一步证实，折射反向学习策略和精英引导的自适应信息共享发展策略均对性能提升起到了有效且协同的...。研究方法：神经网络、Transformer 模型、实验方法、随机过程。

papers.title: Corporate Social Responsibility Expenditure under India's Mandatory CSR Regime: A Comparative and Statistical Analysis of Leading Pharmaceutical Companies
papers.venue: International Journal of Advanced Research in Commerce Management & Social Science
papers.abstract:
Purpose: This paper examines the dimension, trend, and inter-firm variability of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) expenditure among leading Indian pharmaceutical companies across the first full decade of the mandatory CSR regime introduced under Section 135 of the Companies Act, 2013.
Methodology: The study formulates on secondary data hand-collected from the audited annual reports and CSR disclosures of five pharmaceutical companies selected through purposive (judgemental) sampling on the basis of market capitalisation — Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd, Divi's Laboratories Ltd, Torrent Pharmaceuticals Ltd, Cipla Ltd, and Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd — for the ten financial years from 2015–16 to 2024–25. Descriptive statistics (mean, median, standard deviation, variance, skewness and kurtosis) and one-way Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) are used to test whether the mean CSR expenditure differs significantly across the sample firms.
Findings: CSR expenditure rose for every sample firm over the study period, while the pace and stability of growth diverged considerably. Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd recorded the highest mean expenditure (₹45.79 crore), followed by Cipla Ltd (₹40.96 crore), Divi's Laboratories Ltd (₹31.88 crore), Torrent Pharmaceuticals Ltd (₹21.09 crore) and Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd (₹19.84 crore). The one-way ANOVA (F = 4.502, p = 0.0038) rejects the null hypothesis of equality of means at the 5 percent level of significance, confirming that CSR spending among the sampled firms is statistically non-uniform.
Originality: By covering the complete first post-mandate decade for a sector with a direct bearing on public-health outcomes, the study provides sector-specific comparative evidence that complements the largely cross-industry Indian CSR literature, offering an empirical benchmark for regulators, CSR committees, and institutional investors.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】**目的**：本文研究了在2013年《公司法》第135条规定的强制性企业社会责任（CSR）制度实施后的第一个完整十年内，印度主要制药公司在CSR支出方面的规模、趋势及企业间差异。

**方法**：本研究基于市场资本规模，通过目的性抽样（主观判断）选取了五家制药公司（Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd、Divi’s Laboratories Ltd、Torrent Pharmaceuticals Ltd、Cipla Ltd和Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd）的审计年度报告和CSR披露数据，分析了2015–2024财年的十年间CSR支出情况。采用描述性统计量（均值、中位数、标准差、方差、偏度和峰度）以及单因素方差分析（ANOVA）来检验样本公司之间的CSR支出均值是否存在显著差异。

**结果**：在研究期间，所有样本公司的CSR支出均有所增加，但增长的速度和稳定性存在显著差异。其中，Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd的CSR支出均值最高（4.5579亿卢比），其次是Cipla Ltd（4.4096亿卢比）...。

papers.title: Intelligence vs execution: decoupling AI and automation's divergent roles in Ghana's post-COVID economic recovery
papers.venue: African Journal of Economic and Management Studies
papers.abstract:
Purpose
                    This study decouples artificial intelligence (AI) from automation to examine their distinct yet interrelated roles in stabilizing Ghana's healthcare, manufacturing and banking and finance sectors following COVID-19. Rather than treating the two concepts interchangeably, the research empirically investigates how AI-driven cognitive analytics versus automation-driven process execution shaped operational continuity, service delivery and economic resilience.
                  
                  
                    Design/methodology/approach
                    The study adopts a mixed-methods design, combining primary survey data from 4,311 Ghanaian firms with secondary literature. A comparative sectoral analysis evaluates adoption patterns, performance gains and implementation barriers across healthcare, manufacturing and banking.
                  
                  
                    Findings
                    Results demonstrate that AI and automation delivered divergent but complementary impacts. Healthcare, the most disrupted sector (65.4% of firms affected), benefited from AI diagnostics and telemedicine. Manufacturing leveraged automation for predictive maintenance and quality control, though smaller firms faced expertise and cost constraints. Banking exhibited greatest resilience through AI-powered chatbots, despite limitations in handling complex inquiries. Overall, 91.4% of businesses reported sales declines, representing an estimated loss of 115.2 million Ghana Cedis.
                  
                  
                    Originality/value
                    By decoupling AI from automation, this study provides a conceptually precise, data-grounded framework for post-pandemic industrial policy. It offers actionable strategies to address skill gaps, ethical risks and access disparities, ensuring sustainable technological integration for inclusive national growth in low- and middle-income economies.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】**研究目的**  
本研究将人工智能（AI）与自动化区分开来，探讨它们在新冠疫情后稳定加纳医疗保健、制造业以及银行业和金融领域中所扮演的截然不同却又相互关联的角色。研究并未将这两个概念混为一谈，而是通过实证方法分析基于AI的认知分析与基于自动化的流程执行对运营连续性、服务提供及经济韧性所产生的影响。  

**研究设计/方法论**  
本研究采用混合方法设计，结合了来自4,311家加纳企业的第一手调查数据与相关文献资料，通过跨行业比较分析来评估医疗保健、制造业和银行业在AI与自动化应用方面的采纳模式、绩效提升情况以及实施过程中遇到的障碍。  

**研究结果**  
研究结果表明，AI与自动化虽然作用不同，但能够形成互补效应。医疗保健行业受疫情冲击最为严重（65.4%的企业受到影响），受益于AI在诊断和远程医疗方面的应用；制造业则利用自动化技术实现预测性维护和质量控制，不过小型企业面临技术专长和成本方面的限制；银行业通过AI驱动的聊天机器人展现出较强的韧性，尽管在处理复杂咨询时仍存在不足。总体而言，91.4%的企业报告销售额下降，导致约1.152亿加纳塞地的经济损失。  

*...。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: Business approaches to biodiversity: learning from the ecological practices of indigenous entrepreneurs
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  We argue that business approaches to biodiversity can be improved by examining the ecological practices of Indigenous entrepreneurs. Drawing on a study with Indigenous entrepreneurs from Chiang Rai, Thailand, we show how specific ecological practices—e.g., self-identification with nature, individual process of information and collaborative restoration—are integrated into their work. These practices demonstrate a deep attachment to nature, yet they are also accompanied by tensions arising from these entrepreneurs’ encounters with biodiversity threats. Our article contributes to the business and biodiversity literature by developing an ‘endless loop’ model that conceives business approaches to biodiversity as an ongoing journey requiring the participation of business leaders, employees, and the wider business community, grounded in the imperative of moralizing biodiversity beyond market utility considerations. We conclude by underscoring the important role of Indigenous entrepreneurs as land stewards and as spokespeople for other Indigenous Peoples, thereby broadening policy discussions on the green economy
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
我们认为，通过研究原住民企业家的生态实践，可以改进企业在生物多样性保护方面的做法。基于对泰国清莱地区原住民企业家的研究，我们展示了某些具体的生态实践（如与自然的自我认同、信息收集的个人化方式以及协作性的生态恢复工作）是如何融入他们日常经营中的。这些实践体现了他们对自然的深厚情感，但同时也伴随着这些企业家在应对生物多样性威胁时所面临的种种挑战。本文通过提出一个“循环发展”模型，为商业与生物多样性保护领域的研究做出了贡献。该模型将企业在生物多样性保护方面的努力视为一场持续的过程，需要企业领导者、员工以及整个商业界的共同参与，并强调在关注市场效益的同时，必须将生物多样性保护提升到道德层面的高度。最后，我们强调了原住民企业家作为土地管理者及其他原住民群体的代言人所扮演的重要角色，从而为有关绿色经济的政策讨论提供了新的视角。。

papers.title: Coffee consumption across generations: consumer habits, motivations and constraints
papers.venue: Journal of Hospitality and Tourism Horizons
papers.abstract:
Purpose
                    This study explores how consumers from Generations X, Y and Z in Türkiye interpret coffee consumption through the interplay of habits, motivations and constraints. Rather than treating coffee as a matter of preference alone, it examines its social, cultural, experiential and practical meanings across generations.
                  
                  
                    Design/methodology/approach
                    A qualitative design was adopted. Semi-structured face-to-face interviews were conducted with 37 coffee consumers representing Generations X, Y and Z in Türkiye. The data were analyzed using content analysis, and inductive codes were organized around consumption habits, motivations and constraints.
                  
                  
                    Findings
                    Generation Z perceives coffee through the lens of pleasure and socializing, often integrating it into sports routines and preferring brand-led corporate venues. Generation Y emphasizes cultural meanings, showing a preference for stronger coffee and valuing the aroma of freshly ground and brewed beans. In contrast, Generation X prioritizes practicality, opting for milder milk-based coffees and quieter, more authentic settings. Across all cohorts, high prices and health concerns emerge as primary constraints; however, while Generations Z and Y often continue consumption despite discomfort, Generation X is more likely to reduce intake.
                  
                  
                    Research limitations/implications
                    The findings suggest that coffee businesses should adopt lifestyle-sensitive and generation-aware service strategies, particularly in relation to café atmosphere, sensory quality, communication, pricing and consumer experience management.
                  
                  
                    Originality/value
                    By integrating habits, motivations and constraints within a single qualitative framework, this study offers a generation-sensitive interpretation of coffee consumption in Türkiye and shows how these dimensions jointly shape everyday consumption practices.

【金融经济学】**研究目的**  
本研究探讨了土耳其的X世代、Y世代和Z世代消费者如何通过习惯、动机与约束的相互作用来理解咖啡消费行为。它并非仅仅将咖啡视为一种个人偏好，而是深入分析了这一现象在跨代背景下的社会、文化、体验及实用层面的意义。  

**研究设计/方法**  
本研究采用定性研究方法，对37位分别代表土耳其X世代、Y世代和Z世代的咖啡消费者进行了半结构化的面对面访谈。数据通过内容分析进行处理，并根据消费者的消费习惯、动机及所面临的约束因素进行了归纳性整理。  

**研究结果**  
Z世代将咖啡视为一种带来愉悦与促进社交的饮品，常将其融入日常运动习惯中，并偏好品牌化、具有企业氛围的咖啡消费场所；Y世代更注重咖啡的文化内涵，偏爱浓度较高的咖啡，并重视新鲜研磨咖啡豆的香气；而X世代则更注重实用性，倾向于选择口味较淡的牛奶咖啡，同时偏好安静、氛围更真实的消费环境。在所有世代中，高价格和健康顾虑都被视为主要的消费约束因素。尽管Z世代和Y世代仍会继续饮用咖啡，但X世代更有可能减少咖啡摄入量。  

**研究局限性与启示**

papers.title: Fee Implied Volatility on Uniswap v3: A DEX Native Proxy and Its Limits
papers.abstract: Narrow Uniswap v3 liquidity ranges resemble short dated options, and Panoptic's streaming premium echoes the short maturity concentration of Black-Scholes theta near the strike. This motivates a natural question: can implied volatility be extracted from Uniswap v3 and Panoptic using only on chain observables? A direct identification of theta with realized fee income is too strong, since fee income captures only the compensation leg of a narrow range LP position. The remaining leg, the cost of dynamically hedging the LP's negative convexity through arbitrage aligned trades, is formalized elsewhere as predictable loss or loss versus rebalancing and is not observable from fees alone. We therefore reformulate the object of interest. We derive $σ_{fee} = 2 \cdot feeRate \cdot \sqrt{Volume/L_{tick}}$, and interpret it as a DEX native fee implied volatility proxy: an observable, oracle free measure of fee flow relative to active liquidity. We show that recovering a structural latent volatility from pool observables alone is not identified in general, since aggregate volume mixes informed and uninformed flow while the missing hedging cost term depends on external price dynamics and arbitrage timing. What the pool data support directly is a fee implied activity index, not a Black-Scholes consistent implied volatility.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】Uniswap v3的流动性范围较窄，这一特征类似于短期期权；而Panoptic平台的流式溢价现象则反映了Black-Scholes模型中期权到期时间较短时theta值的集中趋势。这引发了一个自然的问题：是否仅通过链上可观测数据就能提取Uniswap v3和Panoptic平台的隐含波动率？将theta值直接等同于实际收取的费用收入是不合理的，因为费用收入仅反映了流动性提供者（LP）在狭窄价格区间内所获得的补偿部分。LP需要通过套利交易动态对冲其投资组合的负凸性，这部分成本在其他研究中被定义为可预测的亏损或与重新平衡相关的损失，而这些信息无法仅从费用数据中获取。因此，我们重新定义了研究目标。我们推导出公式$σ_{fee} = 2 \cdot feeRate \cdot \sqrt{Volume/L_{tick}}$，并将其视为一个去中心化交易所（DEX）特有的隐含波动率代理指标——一个无需外部信息源（如预言机）即可观测到的、反映活跃流动性与费用流动关系的指标。研究表明，仅通过池内数据通常无法准确推断出结构性隐含波动率，因为总体交易量同时包含了基于信息的交易和缺乏信息的交易；同时，...。

papers.title: Breaking the Chain: Division Norms and Criminal Deterrence
papers.abstract: In organized crime, membership moves fastest, deterrence capacity moves more slowly, and division norms move slowest. We model this as a three-stage game: division norms fix how every possible coalition divides its proceeds; the authority then attaches deterrence capacity to named members, before knowing which coalition will form; membership adjusts last, around whoever remains undeterred. Under population-monotone division, the minimum deterrence budget is the cost of a shortest dismantling path, removing one member at a time. When the Shapley value is population monotone, it uniquely maximizes this budget by making every path equally costly.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在有组织犯罪中，成员数量的变动最为迅速，威慑能力的提升较为缓慢，而组织内部的分配规范则变化最为迟缓。我们将这一现象建模为一个三阶段博弈：首先，分配规范决定了所有可能的联盟如何分配其犯罪所得；随后，权威机构根据这些规范为特定成员分配威慑资源，但此时尚不清楚哪些联盟会形成；最后，成员数量的调整发生在那些未被威慑到的成员周围。在“人口单调性”分配规则下，最低威慑预算等于通过逐一清除成员来实现组织解体的最短路径所需成本。当Shapley值满足人口单调性条件时，该分配规则能够使威慑预算达到最优值，因为此时所有解体路径的成本都是相同的。。

papers.title: Parameter Identification in Autoregressions under Discrete Sampling or Temporal Aggregation
papers.abstract: I consider an AR($p$) process that is observed every $q$ periods, either as a snapshot (stock variable) or as a sum over the sampling interval (flow variable). Under fairly mild assumptions, I derive the identified set for general lag lengths $p \in \mathbb{N}$ and sampling frequencies $q \in \mathbb{N}$, I bound its cardinality, and I provide a recipe to compute all candidate points and determine their membership in the identified set. My analysis supports the following conjecture: (i) the error term-variance is point-identified, (ii) under temporal aggregation, the autoregressive parameters are point-identified, and (iii) under discrete sampling they are point-identified for odd sampling frequencies and identified up to alternating sign for even sampling frequencies. I prove this conjecture in some settings and verify it numerically more broadly.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我研究了一个AR($p$)过程，该过程每$q$个周期被观测一次，观测结果既可以作为单个时间点的数值（即存量变量），也可以作为采样区间内的累积值（即流量变量）。在较为温和的假设条件下，我推导出了适用于所有滞后长度$p \in \mathbb{N}$和采样频率$q \in \mathbb{N}$的识别集合，确定了该集合的元素个数，并提供了一种计算所有候选点及其所属关系的方法。我的分析支持以下猜想：(i) 误差项的方差可以被精确识别；(ii) 在进行时间聚合处理时，自回归参数也能被精确识别；(iii) 在离散采样情况下，对于奇数采样频率，自回归参数能够被精确识别；而对于偶数采样频率，其识别结果仅依赖于符号的变化。我在某些特定情境下证明了这一猜想，并通过更广泛的数值验证对其进行了进一步验证。。
